query_examples.question: Which looks of the brand Tiny are for a dress occasion?
query_examples.cypher:
MATCH (l:Look)-[:FOR]->(o:Occasion {name: 'Dress'})
WHERE l.image_key STARTS WITH 'tiny/'
RETURN l.name AS look
